thread:

Eve (Frontend): shipped: UI toggle for experimental ranking (behind ff). no regressions from QA.
Clara (SRE): slipped: infra sidecar rollout blocked by nginx config drift in staging. working on a rollback-safe plan.
Diego (Data): blocked: reranker training pipeline failed for last two runs (feature drift). I have a hotfix PR but need infra to run larger jobs.
Ben (Eng Lead): assigning owners: Clara -> sidecar rollout + nginx drift remediation, Diego -> training pipeline fix + verification, Eve -> monitor UX toggle + telemetry. I'll own the canary rollout and final prod cutover.
Aisha (PM): noted. Can we get ETA estimates? also flag any cross-team deps.
Clara (SRE): ETA for nginx drift remediation: EOD today if no surprises. will post config diff.
Diego (Data): ETA for PR review + re-run: tomorrow morning earliest, need ~8g GPU quota in staging (request submitted to infra).
Eve (Frontend): I'll keep the toggle on canary only until we see training re-run. will add an alert if client-side latency > 150ms.
Ben (Eng Lead): CR pings: @Eve @Diego please review these two PRs: https://git.company/repo/pull/428 and /pull/429. small changes but CI flakes on the data job.
CI Bot: Build #428 failed on integration tests (timeout). retry queued.
Diego (Data): re: CI flakes — adding a quick retry in the workflow to mitigate transient worker timeouts. patch below: 
```yaml
jobs:
  train:
    strategy: 
      matrix: [1,2]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/cache@v3
      - run: ./scripts/train.sh --fast
```
Ben (Eng Lead): thanks. once CI green we can expand canary to 25% -> 100% over next 48h if sidecar rollout done.
Aisha (PM): next steps captured: 1) Clara fix nginx drift (owner Clara, EOD) 2) Diego land training fix + re-run (owner Diego, ETA tom AM) 3) Ben expand canary after infra thumbs-up 4) Eve keep UX toggle + add alert.
Aisha (PM): please add short status update to the OKR doc by EOD (one-line shipped/slipped + owner). ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
Ben (Eng Lead): will do. pinging infra for the GPU quota again. @Clara can you confirm we have staging capacity for the re-run?
Clara (SRE): staging has capacity but need to finish the sidecar rollback safely first. I'll prioritize.
Eve (Frontend): CRs reviewed, left one small comment on copy.
Diego (Data): CI retried and passed for #428. kicking off pipeline now.
Ben (Eng Lead): good news. once pipeline completes, I'll schedule canary expansion.
Aisha (PM): thanks everyone. will follow up in tomorrow standup if anything slips further.
